texts.facts: 3. Present application has been filed by Bhalaswa Dairy Residential Colony Committee through Mr. Jagdish Rathi. 4. The application contains references to Madanpur Khadar, however, the same are being ignored since the present application is not on behalf of the dairy owners of Madanpur Khadar and the said error is being read as Bhalaswa. 5. It is stated that the Applicant is an association working for the development of the residents of Bhalaswa Dairy Colony. It is stated that the This is a digitally signed order. The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 13/08/2024 at 03:05:36 Applicant represents dairy licence holders1 from Bhalaswa Dairy Colony and have filed this application for impleadment feeling aggrieved by the direction of demolition/sealing passed by the competent statutory authorities in pursuance of the order dated 19th July, 2024 passed by this Court. 6. It is stated that the members of the Applicants hold approximately 125 licences and manage around 2,500 buffaloes and cows whose milk is sold to local residents. It is stated that for each group of 10 buffaloes, the dairy owner engages 8-11 persons/workers for looking after the cattle. It is stated that the dairy owners use the dairy plot for the residence of the workers and self with the Sunayana Sibal & Ors vs Government Of Nct Of Delhi And Ors on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101528824/ 2 family as they have no alternative housing. It is stated that the first floor of the structure is used for the residence of the workers employed by the dairy owner. 7. It is stated that the issue in the present public interest litigation (PIL) is with respect to prevention of animal cruelty and mistreatment of cattle in dairies. It is stated that the issue of sealing or demolition of dairy licence holders' residences is not the remit of the petition. 8. It is stated that dairy licence holders have not been made a party to this petition. It is stated that it is the residences of the dairy licence holders which are being affected by the order dated 19th July, 2024. It is stated that the persons represented by the Applicant herein are all cattle owners. It is stated that the said persons are members of families of farmers and cattle owners. 9. It is stated that the present application has been filed to protect the residence of the dairy owners, who are licenced2 and have been carrying on At paragraphs 2, 4 and 35 of this application.
texts.arguments: Mr. Arun Bhardwaj, learned senior counsel for the Applicant states that the dairy owners of Bhalaswa are responsible towards their cattle and the residence in the animal sheds is necessitated due to the engagement of the workers and since the dairy owner along with his family looks after the cattle. He states that the Applicants are before the Court to protect their residences. 22. Learned senior counsel for Respondent No. 11 states on instructions that the dairy owners of Bhalaswa Dairy Colony are willing to relocate the cattle to Ghogha Dairy Colony as directed vide order dated 19 th July, 2024. He states that the dairy owners will file an individual affidavit undertaking to re-locate the cattle along with all disclosures as directed by this Court. He states that upon filing the said affidavit, the MCD and DUSIB be directed to hold further action against sealing and demolition. 23. He states that the dairy owners will bear the expenses towards setting up the animal sheds in the plot allotted at Ghogha Dairy Colony and also pay the requisite charges towards allotment of the land to the land-owning agency as well as attendant charges qua the allotment.

He states that the dairy owners will file an individual affidavit undertaking to re-locate the cattle along with all disclosures as directed by this Court. He states that upon filing the said affidavit, the MCD and DUSIB be directed to hold further action against sealing and demolition. 23.
